programme.desc: Uma "bella macchina", um belo carro - mas não projetado por mestres como Bertone ou Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen de Neuss na Alemanha construiu o Beradino à mão.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o protótipo de todos os carros esportivos, o Jaguar E-Type. O carro esportivo do século, seu design ainda hoje define o pulso das corridas. A História do Automóvel mostra a história da Jaguar e como o carro esportivo mais bonito do mundo foi desenvolvido a partir do carro de corrida do tipo D. O documentário inclui muitas declarações de pessoas que, quando o Tipo E estava sendo projetado.

programme.title: RAAAW
programme.desc: In dieser Folge zeigen wir besondere Reisemobil-Aufbauten aus Zirbenholz in Verbindung mit Tatra-Zufahrzeugen. Außerdem: Ein komplett elektrischer Camper unterwegs im Großstadtdschungel.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Sempre significa, sempre radical e de alguma forma aparentemente fora deste mundo - Lamborghini. Nenhum modelo é produzido em massa, muitos modelos são únicos. Frank Sinatro disse uma vez, se você quer ser alguém, você compra uma Ferrari. Se você é alguém, você compra um Lamborghini. A história do Automóvel mostra toda a história da Lamborghini, até o mais recente e surpreendente Aventador.

programme.title: VW Bus T2 Westfalia
programme.desc: VW Bus T2-Westfalia. Der 'Zauberwürfel' unter den Campingmobilen im Praxistest.

programme.title: Mobiles Reisen im Wandel der Zeit
programme.desc: Keine Lust auf Fernreisen? Dann lieber im eigenen Reisemobil in den Urlaub. Die Deutschen entdecken das Campen wieder - und machen Glamping draus. Der Boom beim Camping kommt aber von der Lust an der Reiseform, nicht von der Angst in Zeiten des Terrors.

programme.title: Mick Schumacher in der IndyCar – André Wiegold & Pete Fink im Gespräch. Teil 1
programme.desc: Mick Schumacher wird 2026 in die IndyCar-Serie einsteigen und damit wird erstmals seit über 100 Jahren ein Deutscher das Indy 500 bestreiten. Pete Fink und André Wiegold ordnen das Debüt historisch ein.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Os anos sessenta e setenta, os anos dourados da Opel. A marca tradicional é elevada a sua expressão máxima. Ascona, Manta, Rekord e GT: Opel é mais do que um carro, Opel é uma atitude em relação à vida. A Opel é colorida, moderna e emocionante, produzindo um clássico após o outro. Hoje todos eles são um culto. A história do setor automotivo mostra a excelência da Opel.

programme.title: Mick Schumacher: Neues Team, neue Mission
programme.desc: Mick Schumacher startet ein neues Kapitel seiner Karriere und schließt sich Rahal Letterman Lanigan Racing an. Wir werfen einen Blick auf sein neues Team, die Ziele von RLL und darauf, welche Chancen und Herausforderungen auf ihn warten.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia do carro - Mercedes Classe S
programme.desc: É um fenômeno, o epítome do luxo, do conforto e da segurança, pois nos anos 50 a Mercedes Classe S é a referência na classe do luxo. O modelo de status dos ricos, famosos e poderosos prevalece contra qualquer crise, mudanças sociais e competição. Cada geração da classe S mais vendida, A História do Automóvel conta a história da "classe especial".

programme.title: IndyCar-Feld 2026: Die Konkurrenz von Mick Schumacher
programme.desc: Mick Schumacher startet in der IndyCar – und trifft auf ein echtes Haifischbecken. André Wiegold und Pete Fink analysieren das komplette Grid, die Top-Teams, gefährliche Herausforderer und das Mittelfeld. Wer steht zwischen Schumacher und dem Podium?

programme.title: Indy NXT
programme.desc: Premiere in Texas: Beim INDY NXT Grand Prix von Arlington treten die Nachwuchstalente der Indy NXT auf dem spektakulären neuen Street Circuit rund um AT&T Stadium und Globe Life Field gegeneinander an. Spannung und enge Zweikämpfe sind garantiert.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Se há um BMW típico, então é o BMW Série 3. É rápido, é o epítome do salão esportivo: o BMW Série 3. Desde sua estréia em 1975, a Série 3 tem sido a líder indiscutível no segmento premium. A série 3 é o carro para cada necessidade: é um carro familiar, um carro esportivo e um carro de corrida. A História do Automóvel mostra todos os modelos e a história completa da Série 3.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve'
programme.desc: Um carro de corrida icônico e um dos únicos 29 já construídos! Acompanhamos o Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve' em sua estréia no Mille Miglia.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: SUV Especial: Os veículos utilitários esportivos se tornam cada vez mais populares entre os clientes. Atualmente, quase todos os fabricantes oferecem pelo menos um utilitário esportivo. MOTORVISION.TV - #SPOTTED apresenta os mais resistentes veículos todo-o-terreno, os SUV de luxo mais exclusivos, os veículos utilitários esportivos mais baratos e os mais recentes SUV híbridos e elétricos. Além disso, o MOTORVISION.TV: Um olhar para o futuro. Todos dirigirão um utilitário esportivo em 20 anos?

programme.title: Die Schöne und das Biest in einem: Der Aston Martin Vanquish Volante (2025)
programme.desc: Zeitlos elegantes Design und kräftige Motoren. Das ist Aston Martins Geheimrezept für den Aufschwung. Nach Absatzeinbrüchen und roten Zahlen müssen die Briten wieder Boden gut machen. Der Vanquish Volante tritt an gegen den Ferrari 12Cilindri Spider.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - Der erste Aston Martin mit Turbo
programme.desc: Mit dem Aston Martin DB 11 beschreiten die Briten den Weg Rich-tung Zukunft. Neuer Motor, neue Technik und ein Design, das alle anderen Modelle pragen wird.

programme.title: Aston Martin DBS Superleggera - Das neue Topmodel
programme.desc: Aston Martin DBS Superleggera: Zur Serienausstattung gehören zum Beispiel LED-Scheinwerfer, eine Lederausstattung, ein schlüsselloser Zugang und Start, ein Audiosystem mit 8,0-Zoll-Display, DAB-Radio und Navigationsfunktion sowie ein 360-Grad-Rundumsichtsystem inklusive Einparkassistent. Serienmaßig rollt das Auto auf 21-Zoll-Alufelgen. Marktstart für den DBS Superleggera ist im dritten Quartal 2018, also zwischen Juli und September. Die Preise beginnen bei 274.995 Euro.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB4 GT Zagato - selbst für 007 zu exklusiv
programme.desc: Dieser Sportwagen ist exklusiver als ein Ferrari GTO. Die hauchdünne Aluhaut senkt das Gewicht auf 1.250 Kilogramm. Dem gegenüber steht ein Sechszylinder-Motor mit 312 PS. Zagato hat ganze Arbeit geleistet. Linienführung und Details der Karosserie, aus jedem Blickwinkel ein optischer Genuss. Die Plexiglas-Abdeckungen der Scheinwerfer erinnern stark an zeitgenössische Ferrari-Modelle. Der Kühlergrill ist typisch Aston Martin-Form.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: A Grã-Bretanha é a nação automobilística mais louca do mundo: volante no volante do lado direito e trânsito do lado esquerdo. Os carros britânicos oferecem tudo menos a média. Seja Aston Martin, Jaguar, Bentley, Morgan ou McLaren: Spotted mostra espetaculares conversíveis, coupé e supercarros do Reino Unido, ilumina competições loucas como corridas de cortadores de grama e revela porque os britânicos são loucos por James Bond.

programme.title: Mercedes S500 e: Luxus mit grünem Gewissen
programme.desc: Wir stellen euch den Mercedes S500 e vor!

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Der deutsche Unternehmer Tillmann Miritz ist Oldtimer-Fan durch und durch. Sein Traum: mit seinem Mercedes Cabriolet 280 SE 3.5 durch die USA. Dazu muss sein Prachtstück per Schiff über den Atlantik gebracht werden. Tillmann nutzt die Gelegenheit und fährt mit seinem Luxus Cabrio die Côte d'Azur entlang und besucht malerische Orte und einen bemerkenswerten Oldtimersammler. Nach einer Spritztour im goldenen Rolls Royce und in einem "göttlichen" Citroen DS wird es Zeit, den 280er in Marseille zu verschiffen, damit das amerikanische Abenteuer endlich beginnen kann.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: In der Stadt, die niemals schläft, beginnt der deutsche Unternehmer Tillmann Miritz seinen Trip mit dem eigenen Oldtimer zu den Autoikonen seiner Jugend im Land seiner Träume. Mit einem von Süd-Frankreich hierher verschifften Mercedes Cabriolet 280 SE 3.5 besucht er den legendären New Yorker Oldtimerdealer Elliot Cuker. Mit seiner Leidenschaft für alte Autos hat Cuker mitten in Manhattan sein Glück gemacht und es vom drittklassigen Schauspieler zum Muli-Millionär gebracht. Eine automobile Lebensgeschichte aus dem Big Apple.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Audi ou BMW, com tração nas quatro rodas ou tração traseira? É uma questão de fé. #O RS 5 e o M4 CS são colocados um contra o outro. Ambos os cupês esportivos de desempenho se unem pela primeira vez. Enquanto a versão Clubsport do BMW M4 vem com uma potência de 460 HP, o Audi RS 5 modificado da Abt oferece uma potência de 510 PS. Quem vai ganhar a batalha? E mais: Raros veículos de afinação do Japão.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Gelebte Oldtimertraume - Long Island / Railroad to Florida
programme.desc: Über die Manhattan-Bridge hinaus nach Long Island führt der Weg von Tillmann Miritz, der mit seinem Oldtimer auf den Weg ist, um automobile Raritäten in den USA aufzuspüren. Im Indian Summer gleitet das Mercedes Cabriolet hinaus auf das Weingut Wölffer des deutschen Winzers Roman Roth, der hier einen der besten Weine der Welt anbaut. In seiner Garage findet sich ein automobiler Traum: Ein 3100er Chevi Pick Up Truck. Eines jender Fahrzeuge, das die Automobilgeschichte in den USA bis heute geprägt hat.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Italienische Sportwagen gelten nicht zu Unrecht als Krone dieser Fahrzeugklasse. Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini, Alfa Romeo - kennt praktisch jeder. Aber Iso Rivolta? Die Marke ist verschwunden aber unter Auto-Enthusiasten lebt die Legende weiter. Im Sarasota Classic Car Museum, Florida finden sich gleich mehrere mit amerikanischen Corvette V8-Motoren ausgerüstete Rivoltas aus der Feder des legendären intalienischen Designers und Tillmann wird vom Rivolta-Enkel Renzo zu einer Ausfahrt im wunderbaren Grifo GT eingeladen. Nicht weit vom Museum entfernt bauen die Rivoltas Enkel heute wieder Traum-Fahrzeuge - allerdings fürs Wasser.

programme.title: Maserati GranCabrio MC
programme.desc: Pegamos o Maserati GranCabrio MC com seu potente motor V8 de 4,7 litros em um test drive através da bela e pitoresca paisagem do Tirol do Sul e exploramos o manuseio e as características desta besta luxuosa.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: Com a Bentley Bentayga, a tradicional marca britânica está entrando no segmento de mercado que mais cresce. Este primeiro SUV de luxo do mundo é um conglomerado de superlativos sobre rodas.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Um touro furioso, alguns ingleses que se prepararam para condições climáticas bastante desagradáveis e um jovem e talentoso piloto de corrida, todos estes foram visitantes que se aventuraram ao infame Inferno Verde de Nürburgring.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Welches ist das amerikanische Auto der 60er? Das Sinnbild amerikanischer Autobaukunst dieser Zeit? Keine Frage, die meisten US-Car Fans würden antworten: Chevrolet Corvette oder der Ford Mustang. Auf der Suche nach diesen amerikanischen Traumautos macht Tillmann Miritz bei seiner Reise durch Florida eine überraschende Entdeckung. Bei REVOLOGY CARS in Orlando werden originale 1964er Ford Mustang Karossen in Handarbeit mit modernster Technik und Motoren ausgestattet und Tillmann darf mit einer dieser wunderbaren Replikas eine Probefahrt unternehmen.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Um Golf 2 afinado, um sedan familiar de Hannover, Alemanha e um Porsche GT2 muito especial. Olhamos para os bastidores do posto de gasolina pela curva da pista de corrida, onde os carros esportivos se aglomeram.

programme.title: Jaguar XF S - Business-Klasse mit britischen Charme
programme.desc: Bricht jetzt die Nacht über die deutschen Limousinen herein? Ein angriffslustiger Brite macht ernst. Der Jaguar XF ist die alternative Business-Kutsche zu den Etablierten aus Deutschland. Und als S-Variante macht er sogar richtig Spaß.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Quando o Nürburgring se transforma em um país maravilhoso de inverno, pode parecer agradável, mas com certeza não é muito agradável como pista de corrida.

programme.title: Morgan AR P4 - Limitierte Sonderedition

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: Trackmasters

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: Der Wettbewerb zieht weiter nach Italien, wo die zweite Runde, der Grand Prix of Sardegna, in Tramatza auf Sardinien stattfindet.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: Classic Races

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.sub-title: Rallye Ano 1972 - Uma Historia de Sucesso Ford

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: An Bord des Mclaren 570S Spider

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: O Volkswagen Jetta é um grande vendedor nos Estados Unidos. Com a sexta geração, a Volkswagen também quer que o modelo tenha sucesso junto aos compradores de automóveis europeus. E mais: damos uma olhada no novo Ford Focus e no BMX X3.

programme.title: BMW Motorrad Days! Das Kultfestival und die R 12 S im Test!

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Patrick Simon analisa o Porsche Cayenne S Hybrid. Abaixo de seu capô há um motor V6 de 333 HP e um motor elétrico de 47 cavalos de potência. Além disso: o próximo piloto de corridas Chris Bauer no Campeonato FIA GT1 no Nürburgring.

programme.title: Kias Kompaktoffensive: Wir testen das neue Sportage Facelift und checken weiter Modelle!
programme.desc: Das Kompaktsegment und SUVs boomen in Europa und ein Ende des Trends ist nicht in Sicht! Kia zündet ein regelrechtes Modellfeuerwerk: Wir checken, was das neue Sportage Facelift zu bieten hat und schauen uns außerdem den EV5, EV4 und K4 an.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: O piloto de testes Patrick Simon quer participar das 24 Horas de Le Mans e revisa seu carro LMPC. Mais: comparamos o Volkswagen Tiguan 2.0 TDI com o Kia Sportage 2.0 CRDI.

programme.title: Defender Trophy: Offroad-Check mit dem Sondermodell und alle Facts zur neuen Challenge!
programme.desc: Defender Trophy! So heißen die neue Extrem-Abenteuer-Challenge und das Sondermodell von Land Rover. Wir checken, was der spezielle Offroader „Defender 110 Trophy Edition“ im Gelände draufhat, und verraten alle Facts zum neuen globalen Wettbewerb.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Como há telespectadores que não estão muito interessados no tema dos carros esportivos. Por essa razão, colocamos o foco deste episódio em carros pequenos.

programme.title: Die Schöne und das Biest in einem: Der Aston Martin Vanquish Volante (2025)
programme.desc: Zeitlos elegantes Design und kräftige Motoren. Das ist Aston Martins Geheimrezept für den Aufschwung. Nach Absatzeinbrüchen und roten Zahlen müssen die Briten wieder Boden gut machen. Der Vanquish Volante tritt an gegen den Ferrari 12Cilindri Spider.

programme.title: Chevrolet C7 Z06 - Getunte Amerikanische Ikone
programme.desc: Was dem Deutschen sein Porsche Neun-Elfer, ist dem Amerikaner die Vette. Die Z06 ist die bitterböse Sport-Corvette mit einer Extraportion Power. 659 PS, serviert von einem Kompressor "Made by Eaton".

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: O Ruf RT35 pode parecer-se com um Porsche, mas não é. Desde 1981, a empresa Ruf de Pfaffhausen (Alemanha) é reconhecida como um fabricante independente. No entanto, a base para os veículos provém exclusivamente da Porsche.

programme.title: PSP New Zealand Jetsprint Championship
programme.desc: A disputa no Grupo A se acirra na segunda etapa em Shelter View, com Matt Hareb, Ollie Silverton e Rasmussen competindo por um lugar no pódio. Tempos próximos e performances consistentes destacam essa rivalidade crescente.

programme.title: Mick Schumacher in der IndyCar – André Wiegold & Pete Fink im Gespräch. Teil 1
programme.desc: Mick Schumacher wird 2026 in die IndyCar-Serie einsteigen und damit wird erstmals seit über 100 Jahren ein Deutscher das Indy 500 bestreiten. Pete Fink und André Wiegold ordnen das Debüt historisch ein.

programme.title: Mick Schumacher: Neues Team, neue Mission
programme.desc: Mick Schumacher startet ein neues Kapitel seiner Karriere und schließt sich Rahal Letterman Lanigan Racing an. Wir werfen einen Blick auf sein neues Team, die Ziele von RLL und darauf, welche Chancen und Herausforderungen auf ihn warten.

programme.title: PSP New Zealand Jetsprint Championship
programme.desc: A 2ª etapa em Shelter View traz um confronto de Superboats, com Reuben Hoeksema e Sam Newdick se enfrentando novamente. Tempos acirrados, velocidade impressionante e a busca pela redenção em Whanganui.

programme.title: IndyCar-Feld 2026: Die Konkurrenz von Mick Schumacher
programme.desc: Mick Schumacher startet in der IndyCar – und trifft auf ein echtes Haifischbecken. André Wiegold und Pete Fink analysieren das komplette Grid, die Top-Teams, gefährliche Herausforderer und das Mittelfeld. Wer steht zwischen Schumacher und dem Podium?

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad
programme.desc: A segunda etapa do Icelandic Formula Off-Road será realizada em Stangarhylur. Os pilotos retornam às colinas que já conhecem do ano passado, onde terão de recorrer a toda a sua experiência para dominar o terreno desafiador.

programme.title: Indy NXT
programme.desc: Premiere in Texas: Beim INDY NXT Grand Prix von Arlington treten die Nachwuchstalente der Indy NXT auf dem spektakulären neuen Street Circuit rund um AT&T Stadium und Globe Life Field gegeneinander an. Spannung und enge Zweikämpfe sind garantiert.

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad
programme.desc: A 3ª etapa da Icelandic Formula Off-Road em Egilsstaðir começa com as pistas 1 a 3. Subidas íngremes, passagens estreitas e terreno difícil desafiam os pilotos — precisão e potência são essenciais em uma das corridas mais difíceis da temporada.

programme.title: Sisters of War
programme.desc: Das Leben zweier australischer Frauen aus New South Wales während des Zweiten Weltkriegs: Lorna Whyte, eine Krankenschwester der Armee, und Schwester Berenice Twohill, eine katholische Nonne.

programme.title: Liebeswahn
programme.desc: Ein sonniger Frühlingstag, ein romantisches Picknick – und ein tragisches Unfall mit einem Heißluftballon verändert alles. Als ein Mann vor den Augen von Joe und Claire in den Tod stürzt, beginnt für Joe ein psychologischer Albtraum. Der mysteriöse Jed, ein Mithelfer beim Unglück, fühlt sich auf unheimliche Weise mit Joe verbunden. Was als zufällige Begegnung beginnt, entwickelt sich zu einer obsessiven Verfolgung, die Joe zunehmend aus der Realität reißt. Zwischen Schuld, Wahn und der Frage nach dem Sinn des Geschehenen verschwimmen die Grenzen von Liebe und Besessenheit. Joe verliert sich in der Suche nach Wahrheit – und in Jed, der glaubt, ihre Seelen seien füreinander bestimmt.

programme.title: Freiheit – John Newton's Amazing Grace
programme.desc: Im Jahre 1856 flieht der Sklave Samuel Woodward (Cuba Gooding Jr.) gemeinsam mit seiner Familie von einer Plantage in der Nähe von Monroe Richmond, Virginia. Verfolgt von dem berüchtigten Sklavenjäger Plimpton (William Sadler), versuchen sie in den Norden Kanadas zu entkommen. Gejagt wie ein Hund und heimgesucht von den Erinnerungen an das unvorstellbare Leid seiner Vorfahren, wird Samuel gezwungen, sich zwischen Rache und Freiheit zu entscheiden. Ein Jahrhundert zuvor ist der Kapitän eines Sklavenschiffs, John Newton (Bernhard Forcher), mit einer Ladung afrikanischer Sklaven auf dem Weg nach Amerika. An Bord des Schiffs ist Samuels Urgroßvater, dessen Überleben mit dem Schicksal des Kapitäns eng verbunden ist. Die Reise ändert nicht nur Newtons Leben für immer. Nach den Erlebnissen an Bord des Sklavenschiffs erschafft er ein Vermächtnis, dass das Leben von Samuel und Millionen Anderer für Generationen inspirieren wird.

programme.title: Payback - Das Gesetz der Rache
programme.desc: Ein junger Börsenmakler in einer von der Mafia kontrollierten Wall-Street-Firma wird verraten und muss für sechs Jahre ins Gefängnis. Als er herauskommt, sinnt er auf Rache.

programme.title: Reset
programme.desc: 2025: Zwei konkurrierende Konzerne stehen kurz vor dem Durchbruch auf dem Gebiet der Zeitreise und Erforschung von Paralleluniversen. Da entführen Gangster den fünfjährigen Sohn der am Projekt beteiligten Wissenschaftlerin Xia Tian. Um ihren Sohn zu retten beschließt Xia, selbst die experimentelle Zeitmaschine zu betreten - mit unvorhersehbaren Konsequenzen.

programme.title: 1920: Die letzte Schlacht
programme.desc: Im August 1920 kommt es vor den Toren Warschaus zu einer Schlacht, die den Lauf der europäischen Geschichte für alle Zeiten prägen wird: Es herrscht Krieg zwischen Polen und Russland, die Rote Armee marschiert unaufhaltsam auf die Hauptstadt zu. Nur ein Wunder kann die Niederlage der polnischen Streitkräfte abwenden.

programme.title: Grand Piano - Symphonie der Angst
programme.desc: Die Angst spielt mit, als sich Starpianist Tom Selznick (Elijah Wood) nach einer fünfjährigen Pause wieder an den Konzertflügel setzt. Seinem ehemaligen Lehrer zu Ehren will der unter schwerem Lampenfieber leidende Künstler das 'Unspielbare Stück' aufführen, eine Komposition, die noch kein Pianist fehlerfrei aufführen konnte. Tom hingegen darf gar nicht anders: Eine geheimnisvolle Notiz zwischen den Noten droht ihm mit dem Tod, sollte er nur einmal den falschen Ton treffen...

programme.title: Amazonas: Im Herz der wilden Natur
programme.desc: Folgen Sie uns in den wilden Dschungel des Amazonas. Die Regenwälder von Amazonien sind sehr abwechslungsreich und werden zu Recht als die Kronjuwelen der Erde bezeichnet. Die Flora und Fauna sind besonders vielseitig, so gibt es beispielsweise mehr als 40.000 verschiedene Pflanzenarten, 427 Arten von Säugetieren, 1294 Vogelarten und mehr als 3000 verschiedene Arten von Fischen.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Al descubrir que su compañera de equipo Lexa es objeto de un experimento encubierto que la está controlando, el equipo de Mutante X busca al médico responsable.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Cuando la vida de Jesse está en juego, Brennan debe conectarse con él y guiarlo a través de recuerdos pasados que han compartido para salvar su vida.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Mutante X debe evitar que un científico clone mujeres para usarlas como esclavas en su club de hombres ultra exclusivo.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Las sospechas de Lexa llevan a Mutante X a revelar un campo de exterminio itinerante, que se presenta como un circo para refugiados mutantes y el enemigo de Mutante X dentro del Dominio.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Muchos de los misterios que rodean a Mutante X se revelan cuando Lexa y Jesse son capturados por el Dominio, y el equipo, junto con Adam, entra a rescatarlos.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un empático mutante que huye de unos misteriosos agentes del gobierno es rescatado por un equipo de compañeros "Nuevos Mutantes", el grupo conocido como Mutante X.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Brennan es capturado y cae bajo el control de Eckhart, quien se ve obligado a trabajar contra los Nuevos Mutantes.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Shalimar se vuelve más cercana a otro salvaje cuando es "lujuria a primera vista", pero las cosas se complican cuando su nuevo novio intenta encontrar una cura para su condición.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un nuevo mutante es secuestrado de su familia, y Mutante X se propone recuperarlo y averiguar cuál es el interés de Eckhart con él.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Cuando una plaga que solo afecta a los mutantes se desata, Adam y Eckhart aceptan trabajar juntos para encontrar una cura.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Eckhart busca un mutante que pueda absorber energía, uno con el que Brennan se involucre románticamente.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Jesse se enamora de un pirata informático, a quien Eckhart quiere "procurar" para corromper los canales de noticias informáticos públicos contra los Nuevos Mutantes ... y en beneficio de la GSA.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.sub-title: El Ascenso de la Estrella Oscura
programme.desc: El equipo se encuentra con algunas personas que intentan ingresar a un laboratorio de Genomex y descubren que son salvajes.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.sub-title: Un Tono mas Blanco de Palidez
programme.desc: Un nuevo mutante con el poder de la invisibilidad está trabajando contra Eckhart y Adam, a pesar de que estuvo involucrada con Adam en el pasado.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un viejo amigo de Brennan los atrae a él y a Emma a una trampa. Emma termina dividida en dos entidades separadas, una buena y otra mala.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Jesse es acorralado en una misión secreta mortal por su padre separado, que está trabajando contra Eckhart.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: El equipo se encuentra con un mutante que mata a otros mutantes al drenar su energía y también puede volver a la vida después de ser asesinado.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Emma se reúne con un viejo amigo que posee poderes de telecyber. Sin embargo, la reunión se vuelve peligrosa cuando Michelle intenta entregar a Emma a la GSA.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Adam es acusado de asesinato por un nuevo mutante con la capacidad de robar los recuerdos de las personas.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un mutante con habilidades telepáticas que puede hacer que la gente experimente, mentalmente, cualquier cosa que quiera, logra meterse en la mente de Mutante X. Ahora los está haciendo experimentar sus peores miedos.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: El ex novio de Shalimar aparece y está tratando de recuperar un huevo de Fabergé que contiene un microchip de extraordinario poder.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: El equipo intenta evitar que Eckhart adquiera un elemento raro, pero un ladrón lo consigue. La mujer que tiene la capacidad de hacer que los hombres se enamoren de ella pone su mirada en Brennan.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Mutante X se encuentra con una nueva facción de Nuevos Mutantes llamada Strand, liderada por el poderoso primer mutante Gabriel Ashlocke.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: En un intento desesperado por salvar su propia vida, Ashlocke revive a un antiguo alquimista egipcio que representa una amenaza letal para el equipo Mutante X.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Ashlocke retrocede en el tiempo para intentar hacerse invencible dándole algo a su yo más joven, lo que llevó a Brennan y Shalimar a seguirlo.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: El equipo se adentra en el desierto para localizar a una bestia asesina que tiene como objetivo a los excursionistas.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Ashlocke está desesperado por encontrar una cura para su condición fatal y se infiltra en el Santuario para chantajear a Adam y conseguir el antídoto.

programme.title: Do I Say I Do
programme.desc: Author Jessica Bender is forced to work with her former boyfriend and editor Mike Pryce. During this association, the two ex begin to realize that the spark of their love is not yet completely extinguished.

programme.title: Game of Love
programme.desc: Ex-Wife Frances conspires with her grown children to force Jake to sell his cherished Seattle basketball team. Will game changing moves off the court help reignite romantic sparks?

programme.title: Amber Alert
programme.desc: A woman goes on the run with her children to escape an abusive husband, who is the District Attorney. He puts out an Amber Alert for them.

programme.title: 40 Below & Falling
programme.desc: A rom-com about the adventures of a small town teacher, Kate Carter, going back to the city for her wedding. After a blizzard strikes, she is forced to travel with a stranger named Redford who leaves her questioning her future plans.

programme.title: All I Want For Christmas
programme.desc: Anxious to help his struggling, widowed mom SARA, 10 year old JESSIE enters a national video contest. But Jessie's winning entry, "All I Want for Christmas is a Husband for my Mom," has unforeseen consequences as Sara is vaulted into the national spotlight and dazzled into accepting a proposal from a wealthy man she may not love.

programme.title: My Mother's Stalker
programme.desc: A single mother decides to meet up with an old high school fling but she gets more than she bargained for when he stalks both her and her daughter.

programme.title: Secret Millionaire
programme.desc: A very rich father wants to build on a local park. His only son fall in love with cute protester, but she doesn't know who his father is.

programme.title: Blue Moon Ball
programme.desc: A writer returns to her hometown for inspiration and reinkindles her romance with her first love.

programme.title: Do I Say I Do
programme.desc: Author Jessica Bender is forced to work with her former boyfriend and editor Mike Pryce. During this association, the two ex begin to realize that the spark of their love is not yet completely extinguished.

programme.title: Game of Love
programme.desc: Ex-Wife Frances conspires with her grown children to force Jake to sell his cherished Seattle basketball team. Will game changing moves off the court help reignite romantic sparks?

programme.title: Battle of the Bulbs
programme.desc: Bob Wallace makes sure to go all out every year on Christmas decorations so that he can have the brightest and most festive house in his neighborhood. This year, he notices that his new neighbor has put up an even brighter and more lavish display. The fight is on when they declare war for the best Christmas decoration display in the neighborhood.

programme.title: His Deadly Affair
programme.desc: Violinist Danielle's dream boyfriend, James the Conductor of the Orchestra, has a dangerous and obsessive wife, who is waiting to extract her vengeance on Danielle.

programme.title: Taken Back: Finding Haley
programme.desc: Unable to get over the abduction of her daughter, a mother is convinced she has finally found her, but is she simply a mother obsessed?

programme.title: The Music in Me
programme.desc: A singer/songwriter leaves her dreams behind to help her family, until one special guy and a group of musically-challenged strangers help her find her voice again.

programme.title: Muérdago Sobre Manhattan
programme.desc: La esposa de Papá Noel llega a Nueva York a expandir el espíritu de la Navidad. Allí conoce a un policía que se está separando de su mujer y él le pide que por una noche se quede cuidando a sus hijos.

programme.title: Navidad Compartida
programme.desc: Dos mujeres se intercambian sus cuerpos mágicamente durante las vacaciones, y aprenden valiosas lecciones de familia, de amor y de espíritu navideño.

programme.title: Nieve de verano
programme.desc: Hallie es una niña pequeña con un gran corazón, pero sus formas de ayudar a menudo crean un desastre.

programme.title: Secretos Enterrados
programme.desc: Sarah es una antigua policía que acaba de publicar una novela con éxito, la cual desvela la causa de la muerte de un confidente de la policía.

programme.title: Capilla de Boda, La
programme.desc: Sarah es una pintora sin inspiración, soltera, tiene mala suerte y quiere escapar de sus problemas. Decide visitar a su madre, y se involucra en salvar una iglesia local que está en peligro de cerrar.

programme.title: Navidad en el Majestic
programme.desc: Nell es una arquitecta que tiene el encargo de transformar el histórico Majestic Playhouse de Briar Falls, su ciudad natal, en un gran y moderno complejo. Ella acepta a regañadientes, ya que es un edificio emblemático donde se exponen los cuadros navideños, una tradición de la localidad. Su tarea se complica cuando conoce a Connor, el nuevo dueño del teatro, con una mentalidad muy distinta a la suya. Nell confía en que si lo acompaña durante el Twelve Day Festival, Connor cambie de opinión sobre la modernización del Majestic.

programme.title: Ya Llega la Navidad
programme.desc: Claire, una inversora de riesgo de Nueva York, se escapa a una pintoresca ciudad de Vermont durante las vacaciones de Navidad. A su llegada, Claire descubre que las celebraciones navideñas han sido canceladas en la ciudad después de una inundación y la librería del pueblo se encuentra en un estado lamentable.

programme.title: La Impostora
programme.desc: Una joven aspirante a actriz es contratada para sustituir a la esposa de un empresario durante una importante recepción en su casa. Lo que parecía un trabajo sencillo se convertirá en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Cámara Oculta
programme.desc: Cuando un reportero ganador de un Premio Pulitzer es asesinado en un hotel en Barcelona, su hermano Dan Kovacks comienza su propia investigación, descubriendo pruebas de que su hermano estaba a punto de hacer pública la existencia de un complot internacional bajo el nombre de "Mega-Bill". Una falsificación casi perfecta del billete de 100 dólares estadounidense. Pero los orígenes de la conspiración van más allá de la falsificación de divisas y podría provocar una guerra nuclear entre varios países de gran poder. ¿Quién trabaja para quién? ¿En quién puede confiar Dan?

programme.title: Crónicas de un crimen
programme.desc: La novelista Hannah Ryan crea una serie de crímenes que alguien imita en la vida real.

programme.title: No Volverás a Verla
programme.desc: La vida de una popular animadora da un vuelco cuando su padre muere en un incendio en su casa.

programme.title: Una oportunidad para el amor
programme.desc: Una columnista de historias del corazón reflexiona sobre la pasión y el amor verdadero en su propia vida.

programme.title: Todo es relativo
programme.desc: Harry y Grace están enamorados, hasta que la madre de Grace pone patas arriba el mundo de Harry.

programme.title: Amor en Bucle
programme.desc: Una mujer se ve obligada a repetir el mismo día una y otra vez mientras trata de volver a estar con su novio, pero encuentra el amor en lugares inesperados. La vida de Amber no es precisamente ideal: recientemente se separó de su novio "perfecto" Kevin, y en su trabajo ha perdido la inspiración. Pero cuando comienza a revivir el mismo día una y otra vez, Amber se da cuenta de que está atrapada en el limbo. Mientras intenta todo lo que está en su poder para recuperar a Kevin, recurre a su amigo Charlie en busca de ayuda, y finalmente debe decidir qué se necesitará para hacerla realmente feliz.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo le reprocha a Irene que no le contó que se había quedado encerrada en el ascensor con el licenciado Basáñez y esta le dice que no le dijo porque no quería que tuviera más problemas y que además fue una experiencia muy desagradable para ella. Basáñez le llevas un presenta a Irene por lo del ascensor y esta trata de no aceptárselo pero al final lo acepta con la condición de que este no le moleste más. Martín es sorprendido por Felipe buscando los documentos de Virginia pero Martin le miente y Felipe le cree. Llega Virginia y junto a Felipe descubren que hay un médico involucrado en los papeles y deciden ir a la casa del mismo. Rodrigo y Adolfo junto a Zamora especulan sobre el uso que le puedan dar los Ferrándiz a la evidencia que ilegalmente les arrebataron.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Adolfo se disculpa públicamente por haber intentado derribar la gestión de Leonardo y admite que cometió un error pero luego le dice a Leonardo que quiere que le firme el documento que dice que lo apoya a cambio de que siga manteniendo voz y voto en las reuniones de junta directiva. Leonardo lo acepta. Virginia y Felipe van a la casa del doctor que firmó uno de los documentos de paternidad y descubren que este había muerto al ser atendidos por su hija quien les dice que su padre estaba obsesionado con el caso y que decía que Virginia era inocente. La hija del doctor les da una carpeta con información sobre el caso y les dice que una de las personas que figura en la carpeta es el verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 134: Luis Guillermo escucha la verdad
programme.desc: Inés, cuando estaba en la biblioteca, ve a Robert abrazando a Marta. Cuando Marta se va, sale Inés y Robert se da cuenta de que ella vio todo. Le pide excusas y le dice que la culpa la tiene Marta ya que ella fue la que lo buscó cuando estaba solo, pero que esa mujer es una insulsa. Inés le da una cachetada y lo insulta. Le dice que ella no lo quiere, y que él sabe cual fue el motivo de que ella se casara con él. Robert en vista de verse perdido, comienza entonces a hablarle a Inés de Luis Guillermo. Que ella también está enamorada del esposo de su hermana. Inés le dice que eso es un absurdo y cuando está diciendo esto, Luis Guillermo está en la puerta oyendo todo.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 135: El amor, secretos y la partida
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo sigue hablando con Emperatriz sobre el amor que sienten Inés y él. Pero él le dice que ya no se puede hacer nada, porque él está casado con Betania y ella con Robert. En la casa del Comisario se presenta Flavia por la cita que habían tenido vía telefónica. También se presenta Patricia para averiguar sobre las investigaciones de su hijo perdido y llega el Dr. Estrada, quien es la persona que está haciendo dichas averiguaciones. Cuando llega Patricia saluda a Flavia y el Comisario entonces se da cuenta de que ellas se conocen. Cuando se aclara todo Patricia se va y el Dr. Estrada la lleva. Michelle trata de convencer a Diego Andrés de que se vayan al exterior. Diego Andrés le dice que de ninguna manera el se va de su país.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 136: El Ultimo Adios de Armando
programme.desc: Todo el mundo está pendiente de lo que pase con Armando y Marisela. El la tiene como rehén. El comisario Escobar está apuntando a Armando y cuando ve la oportunidad, dispara y certeramente le da en la cabeza. Cae moribundo y en ese momento ve a Mariela y le pide perdón y la llama hija. Marisela le cierra los ojos en un mar de lágrimas. Armando Malavé antes de caer también le dispara al Comisario y lo hiere. Se llevan al Comisario y a Marisela a la clínica. Ninguno de los dos está en peligro. Patricia está en la clínica y el Doctor Estrada le está comentando lo que pasó con el comisario. Pero le dice que antes de ir a verlo, vaya con él a su consultorio ara comentarle algo sobre su hijo.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 137: Marisela Nunca Perdonara a Flavia
programme.desc: Marisela se niega a hablar con Flavia y le dice a Diego Andrés que jamás la perdonará por haberla abandonado recién nacida. Luis Guillermo le informa a Inés que Armando fue muerto por la policía mientras se escudaba con Marisela quien es su prima. Flavia se asombra cuando se entera que Armando murió y Michelle le dice que jamás le perdonará que su padre antes de morir haya reconocido a Marisela como hija. Felix y Patricia se emocionan cuando se entran que Luis Guillermo es su hijo y ambos piden a Julio César que se lo traigan de inmediato para darle la buena nueva. Michelle insulta a Flavia por considerar que ella es la responsable de la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 138: Marisela se marcha de la ciudad
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo se asombra cuando Patricia y Félix le cuentan que ellos son sus padres mientras que Rosario le cuenta a Flavia que Marisela decidió irse lejos de la ciudad y que ella pretende acompañarla. Michelle se le enfrenta a Diego Andrés y éste termina confesándole que si llega a saber que el hijo que espera Marisela es de él, la dejará a ella sin importarle que vaya a tener un hijo suyo y Michelle se le enfrenta furiosa y le niega la posibilidad de que el hijo de Marisela pueda ser suyo y le grita que es de Alfredo. Marisela en tanto está horrorizada al pensar que es hermana de Michelle a quien sabe que la odia profundamente y se termina de convencer de la necesidad de marcharse de la ciudad.

programme.title: Episodio 238
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo da a luz a la hija de Adolfo asistida por Arminda, pero Erasto, lleno de odio hacia los Alamo, le arrebata a la recién nacida y la entrega a Carmen Rosa. Engaña a Blanca diciéndole que su hija y su nieta murieron. Años después, Erasto viaja a Caracas buscando reconciliarse con Consuelo, quien sufre junto a Isaías. Rosa, criada por Carmen, queda envuelta en un robo provocado por su hermano Carlos y termina en la comisaría. Alejandro regresa y Rosalía lo presiona para casarse.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri en forma muy sentida le dice a Briggite que era su Dios pero que ahora no quiere verla porque ella nunca quisiera ser una mentirosa y menos aún una ladrona Atanasio quiere homenajear a Briggite pero tiene miedo por Gisela. Armando le dice que haga una fiesta colectiva. Yubiri está esperando que Briggite le diga algo pero esta se quedó muda. Briggite le tira la toalla a la cara y se va. Los muchachos terminaron por fin de arreglar el día de mi suerte y llega el productor..

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Adolfo dice que por asuntos que tiene que atender en el exterior no puede ocupar su cargo en la empresa pero en su lugar deja a Rodrigo y cuando Leonardo se entera se enfurece. Rodrigo llega a la empresa y discute con Leonardo. Luego Alejandra le muestra su oficina y Rodrigo la comienza a besar sin darse cuentas que Leo los ve por el monitor de seguridad. María Lucía descubre a Leo besando a Maribel y se enfada con este y le dice que es un irresponsable y que no quiere saber nada con él, luego llega Julio y también lo trata mal. Julio le dice a María Lucía que él siempre la respetó y que quiere ser su amigo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol llega a su celda y se encuentra con su compañera, Juana, quien le dice que fue contratada por Reina para protegerla. Ricarda luego la visita y le confirma que al lado de Juana no le sucederá nada, y luego le presenta a las demás presas. Luego aparece Reina, y Ricarda se presenta como la abogada de un familia de Madroño, que fue a asegurarse que Sol permaneciera en la cárcel. Luego, sin que Reina se de cuenta, Ricarda le roba su celular. Reina le explica a Sol que la mandó a cuidar.

programme.title: Soldado Universal 3: Regeneración
programme.desc: Cuando un equipo de radicales de la antigua Unión Soviética se apodera de Chernobyl, lugar de la terrible catástrofe nuclear, y amenaza con desatar una nube radiactiva cien veces más mortífera que Hiroshima y Nagasaki juntas, el ejército de los EE.UU. decide volver a poner en circulación a Luc Deveraux (Van Damme), un supersoldado mejorado mediante bio-ingeniería, para que frustre el complot. Llegar hasta la planta no será un camino de rosas ya que su antiguo enemigo Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren) también ha revivido y junto a él encontrará a un Unisol de nueva generación (el ex campeón peso pesado de la UFC, Andrei Arlovski).

programme.title: Campus Code
programme.desc: Presintiendo que algo va mal en su campus universitario, un grupo de estudiantes emprende una búsqueda en la que deberán sobrevivir a fuerzas desconocidas para encontrar respuestas. Tendrán que luchar para salir con vida, enfrentándose a guardias, griefers y, en ocasiones, entre ellos mismos.

programme.desc: La historia de John, un delincuente de poca monta, que encuentra un inesperado cómplice en Louis, un adolescente que acaba de quedarse huérfano.

programme.title: A Vilã
programme.desc: Desde pequena, Sook-hee foi treinada para se tornar uma assassina. Quando é recrutada como agente secreta, ela tem uma nova oportunidade de trabalhar por 10 anos e ganhar sua liberdade. Sua nova identidade é ser atriz de teatro. Para alguém que viveu uma vida de assassinatos, levar uma vida normal não é fácil. Mas logo eles descobrirão os segredos de seu passado.

programme.title: Frank & Penelope
programme.desc: Um conto de amor e violência, um homem com seus conflitos emocionais, encontra sua salvadora e alma gêmea, Penelope, dançando sedutoramente em um clube de strip em ruínas. E uma vida que certamente caiu de um penhasco de repente é redirecionada. Agora TUDO vale a pena. Até morrer.

programme.title: O Vigilante Mascarado
programme.desc: Um pastor e lutador profissional aceita um cargo em uma igreja em dificuldades, onde ele ajuda a comunidade tanto em sua capacidade oficial quanto como seu alter ego.

programme.title: Sangue Na Veia
programme.desc: Uma mulher se vê contra o submundo do crime quando seu marido desaparece durante a lua-de-mel. Decidida a recuperá-lo, ela enfrentará qualquer um que cruzar seu caminho.

programme.title: O Golpe
programme.desc: Dois amigos de longa data, Deuce e Chucky, são especialistas em roubar lojas de penhores e joalherias e se envolvem em um plano para roubar um cofre da máfia. Eles são recrutados com um grupo de pequenos criminosos por Gerry “The Frenchman” Ouimette, o braço direito do chefe da máfia Providence, Raymond Patriarca. Patriarca é um notório gângster e matador que, embora esteja na prisão, continua administrando seu império do crime de dentro de sua cela bem equipada. A equipe realiza então o maior assalto da história americana: roubar mais de US$ 30 milhões do cofre de um negociante de peles que a Máfia usa como seu banco não oficial para armazenar dinheiro e bens roubados. Quando todas as pessoas que participaram do assalto começam a morrer, os dois amigos devem tentar se manter vivos para contar a história.

programme.title: Sem evidências
programme.desc: Dizem que os crimes foram satânicos. A verdade pode ser mais assustadora.

programme.title: Xeque-Mate
programme.desc: Slevin Kelevra (Josh Hartnett) está com vários problemas em sua vida. O prédio onde mora foi condenado, sua carteira de identidade foi roubada e ele recentemente flagrou sua namorada na cama com outro homem. Para escapar ao menos por algum tempo dos problemas, ele consegue emprestado com seu amigo Nick Fisher (Sam Jaeger) um apartamento em Nova York. Paralelamente um plano está sendo tramado no submundo do crime de Nova York. Para se vingar da morte de seu filho, o Chefe (Morgan Freeman) planeja um golpe no filho de seu arquiinimigo, o Rabino (Ben Kingsley). O Chefe contrata Goodkat (Bruce Willis) para executar o plano, que consiste em encontrar um apostador que deva muito dinheiro ao Chefe a ponto de aceitar matar o filho do Rabino para se livrar da dívida. O escolhido é Nick Fisher, o que faz com que Goodkat vá até seu apartamento e confunda Slevin com seu alvo.

programme.title: Lukas
programme.desc: Um porteiro de discoteca é forçado a colaborar com a polícia. Esta é sua última chance de não perder a custódia de sua filha de oito anos. Sua missão: infiltrar-se na organização de um líder perigoso de uma gangue holandesa que falsifica dinheiro.

programme.desc: Em um circuito de corridas, o gângster Gigi (Matthias Schoenaerts), membro de uma cruel gangue criminosa de Bruxelas, conhece a jovem e rica corredora Bibi (Adèle Exarchopoulos). programme.desc: Jai unintentionally kills the husband of a woman that he loves. When she gets diagnosed with amnesia, Jai comforts her and she falls in love with him. Now, guilt-ridden Jai is left in a dilemma whether to confess his guilt or reciprocate her love.

programme.title: Rishtey
programme.desc: Suraj, a seemingly single father, takes care of his little son all by himself, rejoicing in his son's small feats. But his life turns upside down when his wife, who'd left him post a tragic misunderstanding many years ago, returns to claim her child.

programme.title: JD
programme.desc: Media brings news every moment from all over the world, but what happens within the media is not known to the world. JD focuses on this particular aspect of the media. JD unwinds the story of Jai Dwivedi alias JD. He had started his journalism from Lucknow but Delhi has always been his dream. JD breaks the news from inside the media. His pen has the power to shake the seats of power. JD tells the struggles of journalists who fight for the truth and values, but are helpless in fighting for their own rights. Every powerful Establishment first scares, then allures and finally crushes the journalists in a maze of defamatory conspiracies. Thus, the one who rises with a steely resolve from this fall becomes JD. However, the question remains whether JD will confront the powers of media and politics, or he will shake hands with them like many others.

programme.desc: Subir, a popular singer in show business, encourages his wife and a talented singer, Uma to take up singing as a career. However, his pride is wounded and their marital bliss is threatened when Uma's popularity surpasses his own.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

But as they get to know each other more, Jordan starts to see Ellie is exactly who he wants in his life, and hopes Ellie feels the same way.

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

programme.title: A Gift Horse
programme.desc: A grieving, young girl works on the local ranch owned by a business tycoon, when a new horse arrives and she takes the opportunity to regain her faith by training it to win.

programme.title: Quest For Love
programme.desc: Mackenzie travels to Costa Rica for work. Her best friend Ethan comes along to get romantic inspiration for his action /adventure novel. Mackenzie has loved Ethan for a long time, but he only sees her as a friend--until a tourist named Lucas makes Ethan see Mackenzie in a new light.

programme.title: Civil Love
programme.desc: Rachel is a widow during the Civil War who holds the South responsible for her husband's death. When a wounded enemy soldier takes refuge in her barn, Rachel reluctantly helps him. As she gets to know him more, she realizes she must protect him from the dangerous men pursuing him, and discovers a courage she didn't know she had - the courage to love again.

programme.title: After The Storm
programme.desc: Lauren wants to rebuild her community, including her family home, in the aftermath of a devastatingly disastrous storm.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Romance
programme.desc: Actress Emma Hutton is determined to help find her friend Hope a perfect match but in doing so, she accidentally tramples on several hearts. When Emma realizes she herself has always loved her good friend Gray, Emma learns love works best when she doesn’t meddle with it. A charming romance inspired by Jane Austen’s "Emma."

But when she meets Jack Wickham, a good-looking playboy, and Darcy, a sensible businessman, Elizabeth's determination is put to the test. Will she see through their exteriors and discover their true intentions? Based on Jane Austen's timeless tale Pride and Prejudice.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: When you buy a new Dodge Ram Truck there are certain things you’ll want to do to get it ready to tow your toys.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Like trucks, UTVs can be customized beyond our imaginations. But there are also some common problems that need to be fixed.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: They guys diagnose and a repair a crank, no start problem on a Ford Powerstroke.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: When you start with a frame from a C-10 truck there is only one way for this project to go….down. We’ll give the C-10 frame a 2-inch drop and bolt on a ton of cool new parts.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing its Dash installed as well as its interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it’s time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! Mark wouldn’t be Mark, though, without a few tricks up his sleeve. When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: It's the Great Pumpkin, Mark Worman!
programme.desc: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Daren is given control of the shop for a week. Darenʼs constant pestering and ribbing leads Mark to hand him the reigns of Graveyard Carz for a week. But instead of getting things done, Daren starts inventing new field trips and distractions for the crew, as well as becoming obsessed with getting his personal Dodge Challenger running again.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark receives an angry call from the owner of the 1970 Roadrunner, which leads to a mad rush to get the car finished in time. Meanwhile, Josh pushes the crew into committing to some New Years resolutions.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Frustrated by the crew's complaints that he spends all day being lazy in the front office. Mark is determined to prove to the guys that there is more to restoring a car than physical labor. Josh and Daren visit the crash site of the mangled orange 1971 'Cuda.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: As the team works to complete a multitude of cars, Mark stresses over the metal dipping of the very rare and valuable ʻ71 Cuda 440-6. Tensions are high and time is limited, is the GYC crew up to the pressure?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the remains back from the '71 440 Six Barrel, 4 Speed, Shaker Hood Phantom Cuda and determine if the car can be resurrected. A '69 Dodge Daytona Charger arrives ready to be brought back from the dead and Mark gets a 2011 SRT8 Dodge Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the N96 Air Grabber installed on the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car. It's started and is ready for final assembly. The owners of '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car visit to check on the restoration progress.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark is hired to restore the body, paint, and suspension of a '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car. The shop gets some needed upgrades and the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car is completed to OEM Specifications.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The '70 Sunroof Challenger is painted and ready for final assembly. The '69 Daytona Charger is disassembled and readied to be shipped to the media blasters. Mark and the Ghoulz head out to the junkyard to blow off some steam playing paintball.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghoulz use their brand new Shop Crane to lower the body of the '71 Cuda 340 Triple Black 'Phantasm' Tribute car onto its restored suspension and its drive-train is assembled and installed.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it’s time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43’ custom ACI Catamaran "Killer Bee". Armed with the right crew, the right gear, and a never-quit mindset, the guys roll the dice on an overnight move—hoping to wake up to redemption and put a few quality bluefin on deck.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.
